quest.513011004936B5B8.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Terrasteel Helmet (botania:terrasteel_helmet). The items are not consumed by this task.
Have in your inventory 1 × Terrasteel Chestplate (botania:terrasteel_chestplate). The items are not consumed by this task.
Have in your inventory 1 × Terrasteel Leggings (botania:terrasteel_leggings). The items are not consumed by this task.
Have in your inventory 1 × Terrasteel Boots (botania:terrasteel_boots). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.513011004936B5B8.title: Obtain 1 × Terrasteel Helmet + Obtain 1 × Terrasteel Chestplate + More
quest.51301105B3645AB0.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Bounce Lens (botania:lens_bounce). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.51301105B3645AB0.title: Obtain 1 × Bounce Lens
quest.5130110CA84E744C.quest_desc: The Rune of Fire uses Mana Powder, a Manasteel Ingot, a Nether Brick, Gunpowder and Nether Wart in the Runic Altar. Use an individual Nether Brick, rather than the Nether Bricks building block.
After supplying mana, finish the operation with Livingrock and the Wand of the Forest. The batch yields two runes, one of which is used in the Terrestrial Agglomeration Plate.
quest.5130110CA84E744C.title: Obtain 1 × Rune of Fire
quest.5130110DEF4C6613.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Flare Chakram (botania:flare_chakram). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.5130110DEF4C6613.title: Obtain 1 × Flare Chakram
quest.5130110E417B9279.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Manasteel Sword (botania:manasteel_sword). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.5130110E417B9279.title: Obtain 1 × Manasteel Sword
quest.5130111146741C8E.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Elementium Pickaxe (botania:elementium_pickaxe). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.5130111146741C8E.title: Obtain 1 × Elementium Pickaxe
quest.513011241BDCE00F.quest_desc: To summon the stronger Guardian, use a Gaia Ingot instead of Terrasteel on the same correctly built ritual arena. Prepare healing, equipment durability and room to move before summoning.
The task checks the native hard-mode ritual victory. This is a separate combat challenge after obtaining Gaia Ingots; possessing an ingot alone does not complete it.
quest.513011241BDCE00F.title: At the Mercy of a Dream
quest.51301124D2008767.quest_desc: Two Runes of Water require Mana Powder, a Manasteel Ingot, Bone Meal, Sugar Cane and a Fishing Rod on the Runic Altar. Supply mana, then finish with Livingrock and the Wand of the Forest.
One Water Rune is needed for the Terrestrial Agglomeration Plate. Keep the other for later runes: runes used in other Runic Altar recipes are returned when that operation finishes.
quest.51301124D2008767.title: Obtain 1 × Rune of Water
quest.5130112919942EFB.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Starcaller (botania:star_sword). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.5130112919942EFB.title: Obtain 1 × Starcaller
quest.5130112A2549A2A2.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Manasteel Pickaxe (botania:manasteel_pick). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.5130112A2549A2A2.title: Obtain 1 × Manasteel Pickaxe
quest.5130112EF6C53689.quest_desc: The Elven Gateway Core requires a Dimensional Matrix in SOQM. A working portal also needs Livingwood, Glimmering Livingwood and at least two Mana Pools with Natura Pylons above them.
This is an item-trading gateway to the elves. Build the structure using the Lexica preview; it does not transport players to another dimension.
quest.5130112EF6C53689.title: Obtain 1 × Elven Gateway Core
quest.513011302BF63D2D.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Livingwood Twig (botania:livingwood_twig). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.513011302BF63D2D.title: Obtain 1 × Livingwood Twig
quest.513011320C984713.quest_desc: The Hovering Hourglass emits a repeating redstone pulse whenever all its sand drains. Each Sand adds one second, Red Sand ten seconds and Soul Sand one minute; the number of items multiplies the interval.
Use it to meter fuel or item delivery. Check the interval with the Wand of the Forest and observe one item moving before feeding the full supply.
quest.513011320C984713.title: Obtain 1 × Hovering Hourglass
quest.51301132DB8080C3.quest_desc: Earn the native advancement M'aider Stranded Girl (botania:main/mana_blaster_shoot). Follow its requirement in the Advancements screen or the mod's guide.
quest.51301132DB8080C3.title: M'aider Stranded Girl
quest.5130113E6BB0AB8A.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Elementium Axe (botania:elementium_axe). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.5130113E6BB0AB8A.title: Obtain 1 × Elementium Axe
quest.51301141DFD6C1D8.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Terra Shatterer (botania:terra_pick). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.51301141DFD6C1D8.title: Obtain 1 × Terra Shatterer
quest.51301142CC660B14.quest_desc: Livingwood starts with ordinary logs placed around a Pure Daisy. The flower transforms blocks in the world; a pile of planks dropped beside it does not substitute for logs.
Keep some complete blocks for Mana Spreaders and the later elven portal. Turn another portion into Livingwood Twigs for the Wand of the Forest.
quest.51301142CC660B14.title: Obtain 1 × Livingwood
quest.51301143DCC22642.quest_desc: Make a Pure Daisy from four white Mystical Petals in a water-filled Petal Apothecary, finishing the recipe with seeds.

Plant the flower and place stone or logs beside it at the same height. After roughly a minute they become Livingrock or Livingwood. The process transforms placed blocks, rather than dropped item entities.
quest.51301143DCC22642.title: Obtain 1 × Pure Daisy
quest.51301144C02BB91C.quest_desc: Manatide Bellows pointing into a Mana Pool accelerate transfer from the pool into Mana Tablets and other items. Place the bellows beside the pool and face them toward it.
They do not increase flower production. Check their effect while charging one item, keeping transfer speed distinct from stored mana and generation.
quest.51301144C02BB91C.title: Obtain 1 × Manatide Bellows
quest.51301148936871B2.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Rune of Autumn (botania:rune_autumn). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.51301148936871B2.title: Obtain 1 × Rune of Autumn
quest.5130114C6314ADFB.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Elven Mana Spreader (botania:elven_spreader). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.5130114C6314ADFB.title: Obtain 1 × Elven Mana Spreader
quest.5130115157F08B66.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Crystal Bow (botania:crystal_bow). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.5130115157F08B66.title: Obtain 1 × Crystal Bow
quest.51301151FAB0C0E1.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Mana Lens (botania:lens_normal). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.51301151FAB0C0E1.title: Obtain 1 × Mana Lens
quest.5130115554DD128F.quest_desc: The Mana Splitter receives Mana Bursts and divides their mana between Mana Pools placed against its sides. Aim the spreader at the splitter itself.
This block distributes incoming mana; it does not create additional mana. Compare the adjacent pools after several bursts to check the arrangement.
quest.5130115554DD128F.title: Obtain 1 × Mana Splitter
quest.5130115774409001.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Terra Truncator (botania:terra_axe). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.5130115774409001.title: Obtain 1 × Terra Truncator
quest.51301159DE8C0561.quest_desc: The Rune of Earth requires Mana Powder, a Manasteel Ingot, regular Stone, a Block of Coal and either a red or brown mushroom. This Runic Altar recipe produces two runes.
Complete it with mana, Livingrock and the Wand of the Forest. Reserve one Earth Rune for the Terrasteel production plate.
quest.51301159DE8C0561.title: Obtain 1 × Rune of Earth
quest.5130115F50002513.quest_desc: A Hopperhock collects dropped items into adjacent inventories. Place a chest next to it and test with one dropped item. Mana is optional for basic operation, but increases its range.
Item Frames on receivers provide sorting rules. Near a ritual plate or Endoflame, choose the filter and position so the flower does not collect ingredients or fuel before they are used.
quest.5130115F50002513.title: Obtain 1 × Hopperhock
quest.5130115FFF875380.quest_desc: Trade one Mana Pearl through the elven gateway to receive one Pixie Dust. First transform an ordinary Ender Pearl in a Mana Pool.
Keep the portal pools supplied and offer the Mana Pearl itself. A regular Ender Pearl is not the input for this elven trade.
quest.5130115FFF875380.title: Obtain 1 × Pixie Dust
quest.51301160448F0207.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Pulse Mana Spreader (botania:redstone_spreader). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.51301160448F0207.title: Obtain 1 × Pulse Mana Spreader
quest.51301161699ED361.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Manasteel Shears (botania:manasteel_shears). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.51301161699ED361.title: Obtain 1 × Manasteel Shears
quest.513011646F4E0BF3.quest_desc: To produce Livingrock, place regular Stone in the neighboring spaces around a Pure Daisy and wait for conversion. Smelt Cobblestone into Stone first.
Reserve Livingrock for your Mana Pool and Runic Altar. Rune crafting also needs one Livingrock at the final step, so keep a working supply beyond your building materials.
quest.513011646F4E0BF3.title: Obtain 1 × Livingrock
quest.513011682F5E6E47.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Thundercaller (botania:thunder_sword). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.513011682F5E6E47.title: Obtain 1 × Thundercaller
quest.5130116BBA1515FF.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Manaweave Cowl (botania:manaweave_helmet). The items are not consumed by this task.
Have in your inventory 1 × Manaweave Robe Top (botania:manaweave_chestplate). The items are not consumed by this task.
Have in your inventory 1 × Manaweave Robe Bottom (botania:manaweave_leggings). The items are not consumed by this task.
Have in your inventory 1 × Manaweave Boots (botania:manaweave_boots). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.5130116BBA1515FF.title: Obtain 1 × Manaweave Cowl + Obtain 1 × Manaweave Robe Top + More
quest.51301170FB317C97.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Rod of the Lands (botania:dirt_rod). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.51301170FB317C97.title: Obtain 1 × Rod of the Lands
quest.51301171892A045E.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Mana Blaster (botania:mana_gun). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.51301171892A045E.title: Obtain 1 × Mana Blaster
quest.51301173A1581288.quest_desc: Terra Plate: build the 3×3 base from five Livingrock and four Lapis Blocks, with the plate above the centre Livingrock. Supply mana separately through a compatible Spreader or Sparks.
The tasks check each material and quantity without consuming it. Hold the kit before placing it, then complete the separate formation or operation check where this quest has one.
The Terrestrial Agglomeration Plate produces Terrasteel. Its SOQM recipe combines the Water, Fire, Earth, Air and Mana runes with a Manasteel Block, lapis blocks and a Precision Mechanism.
After crafting it, construct the base shown in the Lexica and supply mana. A plate placed on its own is not yet a working alloy-production setup.
quest.51301173A1581288.title: Terra Plate: Complete Platform Kit
quest.5130117ABA3F4F64.quest_desc: Earn the native advancement Invader Girl (botania:challenge/super_corporea_request). Follow its requirement in the Advancements screen or the mod's guide.
quest.5130117ABA3F4F64.title: Invader Girl
quest.5130118142869DDE.quest_desc: Terrasteel needs a Terrestrial Agglomeration Plate on the Livingrock and Lapis Lazuli Block base shown in the Lexica. Prepare roughly half a regular Mana Pool of mana; Sparks above the pool and plate provide a convenient transfer route.

Drop one Manasteel Ingot, one Mana Diamond and one Mana Pearl onto the completed plate. Keep magnets and item collectors away and do not pick up the ingredients: removing one aborts the process and loses the mana already transferred.
Reserve two Terrasteel Ingots for a batch of two Dimensional Matrices. Terrasteel equipment can follow once that supply is secure.
quest.5130118142869DDE.title: Obtain 1 × Terrasteel Ingot
quest.5130118499B8884C.quest_desc: The Open Crate drops incoming items directly beneath it. Feed it with a hopper or another item transport system; this makes it useful for supplying Endoflames automatically.
Use a timer or sensor to limit the incoming items. Redstone on the crate itself changes how quickly some flowers may collect its drops, so do not treat that signal as a universal stop switch.
quest.5130118499B8884C.title: Obtain 1 × Open Crate
quest.513011856E55B526.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Rune of Spring (botania:rune_spring). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.513011856E55B526.title: Obtain 1 × Rune of Spring
quest.51301188861C21A4.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Manaweave Cloth (botania:manaweave_cloth). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.51301188861C21A4.title: Obtain 1 × Manaweave Cloth
quest.5130119992BFAE06.quest_desc: Alfheim portal: eight Livingwood, three Glimmering Livingwood and a Portal Core form the frame. Add two Mana Pools with a Natura Pylon above each, fill both with mana, then activate the core with a Wand of the Forest.
The tasks check each material and quantity without consuming it. Hold the kit before placing it, then complete the separate formation or operation check where this quest has one.
Charge both elven-portal pools and activate the core with the Wand of the Forest. Natura Pylons must sit directly above nearby pools; opening the gateway and trading consume mana.

The native advancement checks that the portal opens. Afterwards, throw in the Lexica Botania to obtain elven knowledge, or test one known exchange recipe. If a required pool runs dry, the connection closes.
quest.5130119992BFAE06.title: World Calling
quest.5130119CD52F2355.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Elementium Sword (botania:elementium_sword). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.5130119CD52F2355.title: Obtain 1 × Elementium Sword
quest.5130119F6CDCBAEA.quest_desc: On a completed arena, sneak-right-click the active Beacon with a Terrasteel Ingot to start the Ritual of Gaia. Collect the Gaia Spirits after victory; they are needed for Gaia Ingots and later the Mythic Circuit.
This quest reads the native victory advancement instead of an inventory item. Beacon buffs are disabled during the ritual, and the number of nearby participants also affects its difficulty.
quest.5130119F6CDCBAEA.title: Dead and Seek
quest.513011A1CAF96497.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Thorn Chakram (botania:thorn_chakram). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.513011A1CAF96497.title: Obtain 1 × Thorn Chakram
quest.513011A3EFF0DCA5.quest_desc: The Diluted Mana Pool is a small starting reservoir. Aim a Mana Spreader at it and inspect its contents with the Wand of the Forest.
A regular Mana Pool holds one hundred times as much mana. Move to a full-size pool before expensive rituals; the smaller, similar-looking reservoir cannot provide the same reserve.
quest.513011A3EFF0DCA5.title: Obtain 1 × Diluted Mana Pool
quest.513011A450B42F4E.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Rod of the Depths (botania:cobble_rod). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.513011A450B42F4E.title: Obtain 1 × Rod of the Depths
quest.513011A5E3EF8710.quest_desc: Trade one Mana Diamond through the elven gateway to receive one Dragonstone. First infuse an ordinary diamond with mana in a pool.
This is a botanical material; the recipe does not require killing a dragon. Test the gateway with one Mana Diamond before offering a larger batch.
quest.513011A5E3EF8710.title: Obtain 1 × Dragonstone
quest.513011A84A267B2A.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Efficiency Lens (botania:lens_efficiency). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.513011A84A267B2A.title: Obtain 1 × Efficiency Lens
quest.513011A8AE758F43.quest_desc: Craft a Gaia Ingot from one Terrasteel Ingot with four Gaia Spirits arranged around it in a cross. The spirits come from defeating the Guardian of Gaia.
Reserve two Gaia Ingots for a batch of Mythic Circuits. A Gaia Ingot can also summon the stronger Guardian, but that second fight is not required to craft the first Mythic Circuit.
quest.513011A8AE758F43.title: Obtain 1 × Gaia Spirit Ingot
quest.513011A9E7BFB8CE.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Rune of Winter (botania:rune_winter). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.513011A9E7BFB8CE.title: Obtain 1 × Rune of Winter
quest.513011B19F1F98A5.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Velocity Lens (botania:lens_speed). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.513011B19F1F98A5.title: Obtain 1 × Velocity Lens
quest.513011B3EC48A328.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Magnetizing Lens (botania:lens_magnet). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.513011B3EC48A328.title: Obtain 1 × Magnetizing Lens
quest.513011B5525C0FAB.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Rune of Lust (botania:rune_lust). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.513011B5525C0FAB.title: Obtain 1 × Rune of Lust
quest.513011B73289AB0C.quest_desc: The Wand of the Forest binds flowers, aims Mana Spreaders and displays stored mana. In Bind Mode, sneak-right-click the source, then sneak-right-click its destination.
Switch between Bind and Function modes by sneak-right-clicking in the air. If a connection will not form, check the mode first; Function Mode assigns a different purpose to that interaction.
quest.513011B73289AB0C.title: Obtain 1 × Wand of the Forest
quest.513011BD49DF9AAC.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Lexica Botania (botania:lexicon). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.513011BD49DF9AAC.title: Obtain 1 × Lexica Botania
quest.513011C18D8A2E63.quest_desc: A Natura Pylon supports the elven gateway together with a Mana Pool directly beneath it. The first gateway needs at least two such pairs near its Elven Gateway Core.
The pylon does not store the mana reserve itself. Check each pool individually; one full pool does not compensate for an empty pool in another pair.
quest.513011C18D8A2E63.title: Obtain 1 × Natura Pylon
quest.513011C8F223AF42.quest_desc: Create Runes of Air in the Runic Altar from Mana Powder, a Manasteel Ingot, a wool carpet, a feather and string. After the mana arrives, finish with Livingrock and the Wand of the Forest.
The batch produces two Air Runes. They are used in more advanced runes, and one is also needed for the Terrestrial Agglomeration Plate.
quest.513011C8F223AF42.title: Obtain 1 × Rune of Air
quest.513011CCCC7AED86.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Potency Lens (botania:lens_power). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.513011CCCC7AED86.title: Obtain 1 × Potency Lens
quest.513011D3AA93F16F.quest_desc: The Mana Void permanently destroys the mana it receives. Placed beneath a Mana Pool, it lets incoming mana continue after the pool fills, but the excess is lost.
Use it where disposing of surplus is intentional. If the goal is to preserve mana, add storage capacity or limit generation first.
quest.513011D3AA93F16F.title: Obtain 1 × Mana Void
quest.513011D5B7ED0426.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Mana Detector (botania:mana_detector). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.513011D5B7ED0426.title: Obtain 1 × Mana Detector
quest.513011D93FA8E783.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Rune of Summer (botania:rune_summer). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.513011D93FA8E783.title: Obtain 1 × Rune of Summer
quest.513011DB110983FB.quest_desc: A Mana Pool stores mana from a spreader and spends it to transform items. As a first test, drop an iron ingot into a sufficiently charged pool and collect the Manasteel.
The pool does not generate mana. If the transformation will not start, inspect the generating flower, its binding, the spreader direction and the actual mana reserve.
quest.513011DB110983FB.title: Obtain 1 × Mana Pool
quest.513011DB791EB2AB.quest_desc: The Dreamwood requested here is obtained by trading a Livingwood block through the elven gateway, one for one. Produce the input with a Pure Daisy, then offer it to the active portal.
The mod also has separate log variants. Keep the requested regular Dreamwood block before turning it into planks or using it in devices.
quest.513011DB791EB2AB.title: Obtain 1 × Dreamwood
quest.513011DEB02F16A6.quest_desc: Earn the native advancement A Realistical Logical Ideologist (botania:main/lexicon_use). Follow its requirement in the Advancements screen or the mod's guide.
quest.513011DEB02F16A6.title: A Realistical Logical Ideologist
quest.513011E3CCB5630C.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Terra Blade (botania:terra_sword). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.513011E3CCB5630C.title: Obtain 1 × Terra Blade
quest.513011E3EC40F79D.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Alfglass (botania:elf_glass). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.513011E3EC40F79D.title: Obtain 1 × Alfglass
quest.513011EAB08A97F7.quest_desc: In SOQM, the Runic Altar requires a Precision Mechanism, Arcane Conduit and Control Assembly. Once built, place the rune ingredients on it and aim a supplied Mana Spreader at the altar.
After the altar has received enough mana, add Livingrock and use the Wand of the Forest. This final step produces the rune; a full progress indicator alone is not the finished item.
Guaranteed return of consumed components: 1 × Arcane Conduit.
Claim the refund after you or your team actually manufacture Runic Altar. An item in storage or an already completed quest alone does not prove crafting.
quest.513011EAB08A97F7.title: Obtain 1 × Runic Altar
quest.513011EC3D07F9A3.quest_desc: Gaia ritual platform: nine iron blocks form a 3×3 beacon base. Put the Beacon above its centre and position four Gaia Pylons as shown in the Lexica Botania. Clear the arena and prepare the summoning sacrifice separately.
The tasks check each material and quantity without consuming it. Hold the kit before placing it, then complete the separate formation or operation check where this quest has one.
Gaia Pylons form part of the Ritual of Gaia arena. Build the active-Beacon arrangement shown in the Lexica and leave the surrounding fighting area clear.
The normal summon consumes a Terrasteel Ingot as its offering. Crafting a pylon and completing the arena are separate steps; assemble everything and prepare your equipment first.
quest.513011EC3D07F9A3.title: Gaia Ritual: Platform Kit
quest.513011EE2F57F8CC.quest_desc: The Rune of Mana has a separate recipe: five Manasteel Ingots and one Mana Pearl in the Runic Altar. It yields one rune and requires more mana than the basic elemental runes.
Finish with Livingrock and the Wand of the Forest. Together with the four elemental runes, this rune lets you craft the Terrestrial Agglomeration Plate.
quest.513011EE2F57F8CC.title: Obtain 1 × Rune of Mana
quest.513011F58C65D660.quest_desc: The Rannuncarpus places nearby dropped block items in the world. Put the target surface sample beneath the soil supporting the flower; it will look for that type of supporting block.
Test with a few inexpensive blocks in a separate area first. Mana extends the range but does not remove normal placement rules, such as sugar cane needing water.
quest.513011F58C65D660.title: Obtain 1 × Rannuncarpus
quest.513011FA714B4E58.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Gaia Mana Spreader (botania:gaia_spreader). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.513011FA714B4E58.title: Obtain 1 × Gaia Mana Spreader
quest.513011FB47984BCA.quest_desc: An Endoflame consumes suitable fuel dropped nearby and produces mana. Bind it to a Mana Spreader, then point the spreader at a Mana Pool; a chest of coal sitting beside the flower does not feed it.
For the first automated setup, use an Open Crate with a feed limiter to drop small portions of coal. Lava Buckets are unsuitable because the flower rejects fuels that leave a container behind.
quest.513011FB47984BCA.title: Obtain 1 × Endoflame
quest.513011FCFC519460.quest_desc: Two Manasteel Ingots traded through an active elven gateway produce one Elementium Ingot. Establish Manasteel production and maintain the mana used for trading.
Elementium supports elven tools and more advanced devices. Plan the input supply around the 2:1 exchange instead of treating it as a one-ingot conversion.
quest.513011FCFC519460.title: Obtain 1 × Elementium Ingot
quest.513011FFAB5983EB.quest_desc: Fill the Petal Apothecary with water, drop in the required Mystical Petals, then add seeds to finish the flower. Each operation uses the water, so refill the basin before making the next flower.
An empty-hand interaction removes the last ingredient if you made a mistake. Lava turns the basin into an item incinerator; flower crafting needs water.
quest.513011FFAB5983EB.title: Obtain 1 × Petal Apothecary
